name: Saimin Datsujo 4 ~Subete ga Boku no Jiyuu ni Naru Sekai e Youkoso~ Tennouji Karen Hen
original_name: 催眠奪女４～全てが僕の自由になる世界へようこそ～ 天王寺歌恋編
source:
Tennoji Karen is an aspiring idol who is currently in training. She is so busy studying and taking lessons that she hardly has time to sleep. Often, she dozes off in empty classrooms, where she meets Yuto. As a future idol, Karen has already attracted attention around campus. Through their secret interactions, they gradually grow closer to each other.

Once, when Karen mentioned that she hadn't slept well and couldn't shake her fatigue, Yuto decided to put her under a hypnotic suggestion in order to help her get better sleep. 

Although it was only for a brief period, she managed to get a good night's sleep for the first time and was visibly affected by how refreshed she felt. After repeating this process several times, however, Yuto started playing tricks on her while she slept.
 Things escalated and he crossed a line. Their relationship continued, and it caught the attention of Saria Mikoshiba, a classmate and model who worked for the same agency. 
Saria saw Karen as a competitor and, sensing something suspicious, began investigating in hopes of finding something to use against her. 
Using hypnotic suggestions, Yuto revealed the truth to Saria and decided to teach her a lesson by making her reflect on her own actions. 
Unlike Karen, Sari actually had a secret lover, and Yuto made her believe that he knew everything about it. By manipulating her fear of exposure, he got her to do what he wanted. 
While enjoying his secret relationship with Karen, who was honest and earnest, Yuto found further pleasure in making the proud and stubborn Saria submit to him.
translation:
天王寺歌恋是一名正在接受培训的偶像练习生。繁忙的学业与培训课程压得她几乎没有睡觉的时间，经常躲在空教室里打瞌睡，并在此过程中结识了悠斗。身为未来的偶像新星，歌恋在校园里早已备受瞩目；通过一次次秘密独处，两人的关系渐渐拉近。

某次歌恋提起自己最近睡眠不佳、疲惫难消，悠斗便提议对她施展催眠暗示，助她改善睡眠质量。

尽管时间不长，久违地睡了个好觉的歌恋醒来后神清气爽、感激不已。然而随着催眠助眠的次数越来越多，悠斗开始趁她熟睡之际对她动手动脚。
事态一步步升级，悠斗最终越过了界限。两人的秘密关系持续不断，很快引起了歌恋同班同学兼同事务所模特——御子柴沙莉亚的注意。
一直将歌恋视为竞争对手的沙莉亚察觉到了可疑端倪，试图暗中抓出把柄借机搞垮歌恋。
洞悉真相的悠斗反过来利用催眠暗示先发制人，决定好好教训沙莉亚一番，让她自食其果。
与单纯认真的歌恋不同，沙莉亚私底下其实藏着一位秘密情人；悠斗利用催眠令她深信自己早已掌握她的全部丑闻，借由她害怕曝光的恐惧心理将她玩弄于股掌之间。
一边享受着与率真努力的歌恋暗通款曲，悠斗更在迫使高傲倔强的沙莉亚屈膝臣服的过程中尝到了加倍的快感。
